runner: function extract(files){let entries=[];for(let f of files){for(let m of f.content.matchAll(/\[\s*(SPECIES_[A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\]\s*=\s*\{/g)){let start=m.index+m[0].length,d=1,j=start;for(;j<f.content.length&&d;j++){if(f.content[j]==="{")d++;if(f.content[j]==="}")d--}let b=f.content.slice(start,j-1),pointers=[...b.matchAll(/\.formChangeTable\s*=\s*(\w+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]);if(pointers.length)entries.push({species:m[1],blob:f.sha,pointers,mega:/\.isMegaEvolution\s*=\s*TRUE/.test(b)})}}return {sources:files.map(({path,sha})=>({path,sha})),entries}}
